id: title:Gilbert09:drop since from the activities pagination cursor

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a warehouse ingestion pagination strategy for Zendesk that strips the Zendesk-specific `since` parameter to prevent 400 errors and support recovery from checkpointed states.
review.reason: Adds a new pagination strategy class and its registration, along with configuration wiring, to handle Zendesk warehouse ingestion. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for the Zendesk warehouse connector, preventing ingestion failures and supporting recovery. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 narrow maintenance is demonstrated; the change is a specific,
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on Zendesk API compatibility and checkpoint state, which are not independently verified. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed; only observations are returned.

observations.behavior: Adds ZendeskSinceCursorPaginator class and its registration in the paginator factory, along with tests.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a new pagination strategy for Zendesk warehouse ingestion that strips the Zendesk-specific `since` parameter from the next-page URL to avoid 400 errors, while retaining the cursor-based pagination. This could prevent ingestion failures and allow recovery from checkpointed states that retained the parameter.

observations.behavior: Adds the ZendeskSinceCursorPaginator to the list of imports in the Zendesk source file.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes the new paginator class available for use in the Zendesk warehouse ingestion module.

observations.behavior: Adds the ZendeskSinceCursorPaginator to the warehouse connector's paginator factory, selecting it when an incremental start parameter is configured.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the warehouse ingestion configuration to the new pagination behavior, enabling the Zendesk-specific fix when the connector is configured for incremental ingestion.
